auth.railCopy: The public lab stays open for everyone. Create an account when you want a private study system — Library, flashcards and Smart Review, with 30 days of Pro included.
auth.pageDesc: Use a clean login by default. If you do not have an account yet, create one in a dedicated step. If you lost access, recover it in a separate flow.
auth.loginCopy: Use the email or unique username from your Atomurus account plus your password. Failed attempts return a generic message and are rate-limited for safety.
auth.signupCopy: Create your Atomurus account. Includes 30 days of Atomurus Pro. No separate Study Cloud account required. The trial starts with your account — no card is required to begin.
auth.fineprint: Use your full natural name and a unique public username. Passwords must have at least 9 characters and one special character, and are never stored in raw form by Atomurus.
auth.recoverCopy: Enter the email tied to your account. If it has access, the authentication provider sends a recovery link. For privacy, the page never reveals whether the email exists.
auth.resetCopy: Choose a new password to finish the recovery flow. After saving it, you will enter the workspace.
auth.signupTrialNote: Includes 30 days of Atomurus Pro. No separate Study Cloud account required. The trial starts with your account — no card is required to begin.
